policy.the_exit_status_is_pytests: The lane runs pytest, captures its exit status, and hands it to the report with --pytest-rc. A non-zero value is final: the report exits with it regardless of how every node id classifies. It also refuses a run whose JUnit XML records failures while the caller claims pytest exited 0, which is the one rewiring that would let a fully-inventoried red run present as green.

policy.unstable_is_not_a_loophole: `unstable` entries are exempt from the CEILING check and from nothing else - they still fail pytest, and pytest still fails the lane. Each carries the number of runs it was observed over and the number in which it failed; the schema refuses an entry without them, and refuses one that failed every run it was seen in. An unstable entry that PASSES is reported as a notice, not silently, so that a genuine fix to the contamination is still visible to whoever made it.
